headline: White House Adviser Hassett Says US and Canada Are Very Close to Trade Deal
summary: White House adviser Kevin Hassett stated that the United States and Canada are very close to reaching a trade agreement.
why: Trade agreements between the US and Canada shape cross-border supply chains, tariff levels, and key export industries including autos and agriculture.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Progress toward a bilateral trade agreement reduces tariff uncertainty for Canadian exporters.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Securing market access to the United States protects core export volumes and capital investment.

why_moved: Prospects of an imminent bilateral agreement ease trade friction risks between the two major North American trading partners.
